import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0123 {α : Type*} {s t : Set α} (hs : s ⊆ t) : s × s ⊆ t × t := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0123 {α : Type*} {s t : Set α} (hs : s ⊆ t) : s × s ⊆ t × t := by
  intros x y
  have : (x, y) ∈ s × s := by assumption
  rw [prod.mem]
  exact prod_mono hs hs
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0123 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0123 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0123

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0123
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0123
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
